cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

# Controller input display overlay (mad2/mods/inputdisplay.dll). Hooks
# Direct3DCreate9 at the IAT level (same technique as mad2igttimer/
# mad2shadowfix) to draw a per-frame HUD, reading controller state from
# mad2xinput (mad2/mods/mad2xinput.dll) and settings from mad2config
# (mad2/mods/mad2config.dll) rather than hooking XInput itself or reading
# env vars. Button icons are embedded at compile time (see
# src/embedded_assets.h, generated by tools/gen_embedded_assets.py from the
# Kenney Input Prompts pack) -- no runtime asset files to deploy.
add_mad2_mod(inputdisplay
    SOURCES src/inputdisplay.cpp
)
